name: Garnier Hair Food Banana
description: Experience targeted hair restoration with Garnier Ultimate Blends Hair Food Banana, a 390ml conditioning treatment designed for parched & fragile hair. This advanced formula harnesses banana & shea butter superfood extracts combined with 98% natural-origin components in a fully vegan composition. The ultra-lightweight, rapidly absorbing mask seamlessly integrates into any hair care regimen whether as a concentrated weekly treatment, overnight repair protocol, or standard rinse-out conditioner. Clinically validated to reduce mechanical breakage after just one application, it reconstructs hair strength & restores natural radiance without accumulation. Ideal for discerning consumers seeking evidence-based, ethically sourced hair care solutions.
